recipe.visualDefinition: A monochromatic sepia-toned portrait of a woman with 1970s feathered hair and bangs, framed by soft-focus foliage. The composition uses high-contrast halftone textures and tight, stacked serif typography in the corners to create a balanced, nostalgic editorial layout.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's eyes serve as the central focal point, framed by the dark mass of hair.
Typography is anchored to the corners, creating a frame around the central portrait.
The sepia color palette unifies the photographic grain with the graphic elements.
coreInvariants: Monochromatic sepia/brown ink on aged paper background.
Tight line spacing in all typographic blocks.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale centered portrait occupying the middle 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, circular graphic element in the top right corner provides a heavy visual counterweight to the text in the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left title, moves down to the subject's eyes, then to the artist name in the bottom-left, and finally to the circular badge in the top-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with hair, foliage, and text blocks.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep Umber/Sepia for shadows and ink.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cream/Off-white for highlights and paper base.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted Red for the circular badge background.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high value contrast between ink and paper.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly limited to two-tone or three-tone printing

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'g' with a distinctive open loop
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Mixing upright bold serifs with lighter italicized serifs from the same family.
graphicDevices: Circular badge with heavy sans-serif text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the soft, rounded 70s serif aesthetic.
Matches the high-contrast, elegant feel of the top-left text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochromatic sepia-toned portrait of a woman with 1970s feathered hair and bangs. Include soft-focus white flowers in the foreground. The image should have a visible halftone print grain and aged paper texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold serif text in the bottom-left corner with extremely tight line spacing. Add italicized serif text in the top-left. Place a dark circular badge in the top-right with heavy sans-serif lettering inside.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic sepia?
Is the typography tightly stacked with minimal leading?
Does the image have a visible halftone dot pattern?
Is the subject's hair style characteristic of the mid-1970s?

mustRedesign: Any modern logos or brand marks
Specific artist names or song titles

mustAchieve: High-contrast photographic clarity despite the grain

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure the subject's eyes.
Check that the halftone texture is consistent across the image.
Verify the 'aged paper' yellowing in the highlights.
Confirm the circular badge is a distinct visual anchor.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered 70s-style portrait + sepia halftone filter + corner-anchored high-contrast serif typography + tight leading.
